title: SCCGBench: Executability-Oriented Evaluation for Real-World Web Service-Call Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.12920v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-generated service-call code is increasingly important for service computing, where developers rely on large language models (LLMs) to compose services and invoke third-party services. However, current approaches have not yet evaluated the invocation and execution of services in the actual code environment. To support execution-grounded evaluation, we present the Service-Call Code Generation Benchmark (SCCGBench), a benchmark of 3,135 traceable and decontamination-filtered RapidAPI call functions from real GitHub repositories. SCCGBench uses redacted-intent generation to reduce circular leakage and introduces Mock, Robust, ParamF1, and host-, endpoint-, method-, and parameter-level diagnostics. Mock denotes a virtual-execution hit that simultaneously matches the gold host, endpoint, and HTTP method, while Robust further requires status checking and exception handling. We evaluate six code LLMs and one non-neural retrieval baseline und

translated_title: SCCGBench：面向真实世界Web服务调用代码生成的可执行性评估
translated_abstract: LLM生成的服务调用代码在服务计算中日益重要，开发者依赖大语言模型（LLM）来组合服务和调用第三方服务。然而，现有方法尚未在实际代码环境中评估服务的调用与执行情况。为支持基于实际执行的评估，我们提出了服务调用代码生成基准（SCCGBench），该基准包含3,135个来自真实GitHub仓库、可追溯且经过去污染过滤的RapidAPI调用函数。SCCGBench采用脱敏意图生成来减少循环泄露问题，并引入了Mock、Robust、ParamF1指标以及主机级、端点级、方法级和参数级的多层级诊断。其中，Mock表示在虚拟执行中同时匹配标准主机、端点和HTTP方法的命中情况，而Robust进一步要求代码具备状态检查和异常处理能力。我们评估了六个代码LLM和一个非神经检索基线……
tldr: 该论文提出了SCCGBench，一个基于真实GitHub代码构建的、面向可执行性的Web服务调用代码生成基准，通过虚拟执行命中、鲁棒性要求及主机/端点/方法/参数多层级诊断，实现了对LLM服务调用代码在实际执行环境中的评估。
